subject: EU telecom reference advocates for QoS RFP
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:15:00 +02:00
Subject: EU telecom reference advocates for QoS RFP

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

We have a late-stage RFP with NordicTel (contact: Anna Bergström) focused on low-latency inference at the edge for call analytics and QoS monitoring. They specifically asked for references who have:
- Telecom-scale throughput (100k+ concurrent streams)
- Sub-50ms median token latency for short inference hops
- Deployed across multi-region (EU) edge sites

Can you nominate 2–3 customers who fit that profile and are willing to take a short (20–30m) reference call in the next week? I pulled a quick candidate list and attached it (candidate-list.csv). Prefer folks that can speak to both performance/ops and procurement.

Target timeline: intro email today, calls Tues/Wed next week (CEST).

If you think Emil at Telenova or Sindre at NordicEdge are good fits, flag their availability and any call prep notes (what they can or cannot share publicly).

Thanks — I need to send the intro to Anna by EOD so we can lock schedules.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com
+44 20 7183 XXXX

Attachment: candidate-list.csv (CSV: customer,region,use_case,primary_contact,notes)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:02:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU telecom reference advocates for QoS RFP

Steph — quick notes:

1) Telenova (Sweden) — Emil Karlsson <emil.karlsson@telenova.se>. Live in prod for two months; they run inference at PoP edge with 80–120k concurrent sessions. Emil is comfortable on a reference call and can explain our batching/caching setup and kernel tuning.

2) Nordi cEdge (Norway) — Sindre Hansen. Good on latency at scale but more cautious on sharing hard numbers; can speak to rollouts and SLA behavior.

3) AirConnect (Germany) — procurement might prefer this one for billing/contract talk; their CS lead is good on contract/ops questions but not the best on kernel-level details.

I attached a one-pager with quick talking points for Emil and a snippet of the performance dashboard (sanitized). Emil confirmed in Slack he can join a 30m call Tues/Wed next week, mornings CEST.

Marcus
Sr Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: emil-talk-track.txt

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Anna Bergström <anna.bergstrom@telco-eu.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Emil Karlsson <emil.karlsson@telenova.se>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:20:00 +02:00
Subject: Intro: quick reference calls for NordicTel RFP (QoS/latency)

Hi Anna — great speaking earlier. Per our conversation, I looped in two Redwood customers who can speak to QoS and latency at telecom scale. Please see the proposed options below — I kept these to 20–30 minutes so your procurement/technical stakeholders can get the highlights.

Proposed references (short options):
- Emil Karlsson — Telenova (Sweden). Prod deployment: edge inference across PoPs, experience on kernel/quantization tuning. Emil is available Tue/Wed next week mornings CEST.
- Sindre Hansen — NordicEdge (Norway). Strong on rollout and SLA tradeoffs; prefers higher-level ops discussion.

Suggested agenda (20–30m):
1) 5m — intros & scope of RFP (Anna / NordicTel)
2) 10–15m — reference experience (deployment shape, latency numbers, ops tradeoffs)
3) 5–10m — Q&A / procurement notes

Attachments: telecom-qos-case-study-Redwood.pdf (short customer story), candidate-list.csv (internal).

If Emil works for you, Emil — can you confirm Tue 11:00–12:30 CEST or Wed 09:00–11:00 CEST? I can send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Calendly (to pick a slot): https://calendly.com/stephanie-nguyen/30min
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890/DEAL-2026-087

Thanks — I’ll keep the intro light and only include what’s helpful for procurement.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: telecom-qos-case-study-Redwood.pdf

From: Anna Bergström <anna.bergstrom@telco-eu.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@teleitalia.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 07:30:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intro: quick reference calls for NordicTel RFP (QoS/latency)

Thanks Stephanie — the agenda looks great and the case study was helpful. Procurement (cc'd: Luca) would like one reference that can also speak to pricing/contract structure briefly. Emil looks ideal — Emil, are you able to cover a short procurement Q&A?

We can do Tue 11:30 CEST. If that works for Emil, please send invite. Also please confirm if any NDA or redaction is needed; procurement will want to capture non-confidential numbers.

Best regards,
Anna Bergström
Head of Solutions — NordicTel
anna.bergstrom@telco-eu.com
+46 8 555 0XXX

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Anna Bergström <anna.bergstrom@telco-eu.com>, Emil Karlsson <emil.karlsson@telenova.se>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Luca Rossi <luca.rossi@teleitalia.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:45:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Intro: quick reference calls for NordicTel RFP (QoS/latency) — confirmed Tue 11:30 CEST

Thanks all — confirmed: Tue 17 Aug 2026, 11:30–12:00 CEST (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent.

Quick logistics:
- Emil, you can keep any sensitive production numbers high-level (Marcus provided sanitized dashboard snippets). Procurement will capture non-confidential pricing ranges; if you need a short script, Marcus has a one-pager.
- Anna / Luca — attached is the short case study and the two-slide summary for the call.
- No additional NDA needed for this intro; if procurement requires anything formal we can follow up.

I’ll send the calendar invite and a 2-slide agenda. Appreciate you taking the time, Emil.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com
